connectionTypes.sourceNote: PRIMARY — Nagaland Electricity Regulatory Commission (NERC), Tariff Order for FY 2025-26, Table 8.3 'Tariff approved by the Commission for FY 2025-26' (Category 'D' Commercial, telescopic billing): <60 units @ Rs 8.15/kWh, 61-240 units @ Rs 9.45/kWh, >240 units @ Rs 9.85/kWh; monthly minimum charge Rs 200/kW of contract demand. http://nerc.org.in/images/doc/TRUE_UP_FY_2022-23_APR_FY_2024-25_.pdf (combined True-up/APR/Tariff Order document).

PRIMARY — NERC Tariff Order for FY 2025-26, Table 8.3 (Category 'B' Industrial, telescopic billing): <500 units @ Rs 7.15/kWh, 501-5000 units @ Rs 7.75/kWh, >5000 units @ Rs 8.25/kWh; monthly minimum charge Rs 200/kW of contract demand. http://nerc.org.in/images/doc/TRUE_UP_FY_2022-23_APR_FY_2024-25_.pdf.

PRIMARY — NERC Tariff Order for FY 2025-26, Table 8.3 (Category 'H' Agriculture): flat Rs 3.65/kWh for all units, no minimum/fixed charge listed for this category. http://nerc.org.in/images/doc/TRUE_UP_FY_2022-23_APR_FY_2024-25_.pdf.
